name: new-skin-feature
description: Workflow for adding a new feature to an existing skin (spec → implement → test)

skinName.description: Which skin to modify (dracula, frankenstein, skeleton)

featureName.description: Name of the feature to add (e.g., 'blood-pool-effect', 'eye-glow')

featureDescription.description: Brief description of what this feature does

steps.name: Create Feature Specification
Implement Feature
steps.prompt:
Implement the feature specified in {{specPath}}.

Modify these files as needed:
- `src/renderer/skins/{{skinName}}Skin.ts` (capitalize first letter)
- `src/renderer/style.css` (add CSS for .{{skinName}}-skin)

Follow patterns from existing code. Run `npm run typecheck` to verify.

Implementation only — do not update spec yet.

steps.name: Test Implementation
Update Spec with Implementation Notes
steps.prompt:
Update {{specPath}} to mark it complete:

1. Change Status to 'Complete'
2. Fill in 'Implementation Notes' section:
   - What changed from original design (if anything)
   - Lessons learned
   - Any deferred items

Test results: {{testResults}}

steps.name: Update AGENTS.md
steps.prompt:
If this feature introduced any new lessons or decisions, update AGENTS.md:

- Add to 'Decisions' section if it's a project-level choice
- Add to 'Common Pitfalls' if it revealed a gotcha
- Add to relevant skin's decision history

Feature: {{skinName}} {{featureName}}
Spec: {{finalSpecPath}}

Only update if there's a lesson worth recording. Otherwise skip.
